comparison.objective: Hand-install a spin-on oil filter within a prescribed post-contact turn range; candidate replaces a harness connector.
comparison.physical_skill: Thread engagement and controlled hand rotation versus connector latch manipulation and translational mating.
comparison.success_condition: PR tracks thread retention, gasket contact, hand-driven rotation, and over-tightening; candidate lacks part, pose, latch, seal, and damage thresholds.
comparison.reason: The PR tests threaded gasket compression, not electrical connector replacement.
